claims.rationale: The claim accurately synthesizes components from three sources: DE_DE12 describes Policy Enforcement Points (PEP) and industry compliance systems as inputs for access decisions; DE_DE17 defines governance as the enforcement of cybersecurity policies/procedures and recommends monitoring/assessing security capabilities; and DE_DE11 details ABAC requirements including consistent attribute values, lifecycle management, policy alignment in federated enterprises, and procedures for access failures.

The claim precisely lists the requirements found in DE_DE13: secure storage (avoiding HTML5 Local Storage), secure transport (authenticated protected channel), session timeout, prohibition of insecure fallback (https to http), session-identifier verification, cookie restrictions (HTTPS only, minimum hostnames, HttpOnly), and the restriction that OAuth access tokens alone do not imply subscriber presence.
